mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, MIN(PO.OPTION_PRICE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PO.OPTION_ID ASC) AS PRICE, NVL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(SCORE), 1) FROM REVIEW R WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID), 0.0) AS SCORE FROM PRODUCT P JOIN CATEGORY_DETAIL CD ON P.PRODUCT_ID = CD.PRODUCT_ID JOIN CATEGORY C ON CD.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID JOIN OPTION_DETAIL OD ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OD.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_TITLE order by product_id desc
